questions.question: status column'ida 100 row bor: 60 'active', 30 'banned', 10 NULL. Natija nechta row?
questions.snippet: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE status <> 'active';
options: 30 — NULL row'lar tushib qoladi, chunki NULL <> 'active' natijasi UNKNOWN
questions.explanation: Bu eng ko'p uchraydigan 'yo'qolgan row'lar' sababi. To'g'ri yozish: WHERE status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active' (Postgres) yoki WHERE status <> 'active' OR status IS NULL. Xuddi shu tarzda NOT IN va ba'zi JOIN shartlari ham NULL bilan kutilmagan natija beradi.

questions.question: PostgreSQL'da natija?
questions.snippet: SELECT 5 / 2 AS a, 5.0 / 2 AS b, AVG(x) FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) t(x);
options: 2, 2.5, 1.5 — butun sonlar bo'linishi butun son beradi (kasr tashlanadi)
questions.explanation: integer / integer = integer. Foiz hisoblashda klassik xato: (count_a / count_b) * 100 doim 0 chiqadi. Tuzatish: 100.0 * a / b yoki a::numeric / b. Pul bilan ishlashda umuman float ishlatmang — numeric yoki minor unit integer.

questions.question: Sahifalash paytida ba'zi row'lar ikki marta, ba'zilari umuman ko'rinmayapti. Sabab?
questions.snippet: SELECT * FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 40;
options: ORDER BY unikal emas: bir xil created_at'li row'lar tartibi har query'da boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin. Tie-breaker kerak: ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
questions.explanation: Barqaror tartib uchun ORDER BY oxirida unikal column bo'lishi shart. Qo'shimcha sabab: page'lar orasida yangi row qo'shilsa OFFSET siljiydi — keyset (cursor) pagination bu muammoni ham yechadi. ORDER BY'siz LIMIT esa umuman kafolatsiz tartib beradi.

questions.question: Transaction rollback bo'ldi. id ketma-ketligi qanday bo'ladi?
options: 6 — sequence transaction'ga bo'ysunmaydi, rollback qilinmaydi; shuning uchun id'larda bo'shliqlar bo'lishi normal
questions.explanation: Bu ataylab qilingan: aks holda har INSERT sequence ustida lock talab qilardi. Oqibati: id ketma-ket deb faraz qilish (masalan 'bugun nechta buyurtma bo'ldi' ni max(id)-min(id) bilan hisoblash) — xato. Xuddi shunday, id tartibi vaqt tartibini kafolatlamaydi (parallel transaction'lar turli vaqtda commit bo'ladi).

questions.question: timestamp va timestamptz farqi bo'yicha qaysi to'g'ri?
questions.snippet:
SET timezone = 'Asia/Tashkent';
SELECT now()::timestamp, now()::timestamptz;
options: timestamptz lahzani UTC sifatida saqlaydi va ko'rsatishda sessiya zonasiga o'giradi; timestamp esa zonasiz 'devordagi soat' — turli zonadagi serverlarda bir xil qiymat boshqa lahzani anglatadi
questions.explanation: Qoida: hodisa vaqti (created_at, logged_at) uchun DOIM timestamptz. timestamp faqat zona ma'nosiz bo'lgan holatlarda (tug'ilgan sana, 'har kuni 09:00'). Tipik bug: timestamp column'ga UTC yozib, lokal zonada o'qish — 5 soatlik siljish. DST o'tishida esa lokal vaqt takrorlanadi yoki yo'qoladi.

questions.question: Bu UPDATE ... FROM da nima xavf bor?
questions.snippet:
UPDATE orders o
SET status = p.status
FROM payments p
WHERE p.order_id = o.id;
options: Bitta order uchun bir nechta payment bo'lsa, qaysi qiymat yozilishi aniqlanmagan — natija tasodifiy va takrorlanmaydi. Avval agregatsiya yoki DISTINCT ON bilan bitta row'ga keltirish kerak
questions.explanation: SQL bu holatda xato bermaydi — jimgina bitta mos row'ni tanlaydi. Xavfsiz yozish: FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id) order_id, status FROM payments ORDER BY order_id, created_at DESC) p. Xuddi shunday JOIN bilan UPDATE ham dublikat row'larni yashiradi.

questions.question: DISTINCT ON (PostgreSQL) to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
options: Ha, har user'ning oxirgi buyurtmasini beradi
Yo'q — ORDER BY birinchi DISTINCT ON column'idan boshlanishi shart: ORDER BY user_id, created_at DESC. Aks holda xato yoki kutilmagan row qaytadi
questions.explanation: DISTINCT ON har guruhdan ORDER BY bo'yicha BIRINCHI row'ni oladi — shuning uchun tartib guruh column'idan boshlanishi kerak. Muqobil yozuv: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) = 1 — ko'proq portativ, lekin ko'pincha sekinroq.

questions.question: CHAR(10) column'da saqlangan 'abc' bilan taqqoslash:
questions.snippet:
-- c CHAR(10) column'ida 'abc' saqlangan
SELECT c = 'abc', length(c), c || '!' FROM t;
options: true, 3, 'abc       !' — CHAR bo'shliq bilan to'ldiriladi: taqqoslashda bo'shliqlar e'tiborga olinmaydi, lekin konkatenatsiyada ular chiqadi
questions.explanation: CHAR(n) — deyarli har doim keraksiz tip: padding kutilmagan natijalar beradi (konkatenatsiya, uzunlik, ba'zi funksiyalar). Postgres'da length() padding'ni hisobga olmaydi, char_length esa... aynan shu chalkashlik sababli amaliyotda faqat text yoki varchar ishlatiladi.

questions.question: Nega bu query kutilganidan kam row qaytaradi?
questions.snippet:
SELECT u.id, o.total
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid';
questions.explanation: WHERE dagi o.status LEFT JOIN'ni INNER JOIN'ga aylantiradi: buyurtmasiz user'lar uchun o.status NULL bo'ladi va NULL = 'paid' hech qachon TRUE emas, shuning uchun row tashlanadi. To'g'risi — shartni ON ichiga ko'chirish: LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id AND o.status = 'paid'. Qoida: LEFT JOIN'ning o'ng tomonidagi filtr ON'da, chap tomondagi filtr WHERE'da.

questions.question: Nega `WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM bans)` bo'sh natija qaytarishi mumkin?
questions.snippet: -- bans.user_id ustunida NULL bor
questions.explanation: NOT IN ro'yxatida bitta NULL bo'lsa, natija hech qachon TRUE bo'lmaydi (3-qiymatli mantiq: id <> NULL = UNKNOWN), shuning uchun query bo'sh qaytaradi. Yechimlar: NOT EXISTS (NULL'ga sezgir emas), yoki subquery'ga WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL qo'shish. NOT EXISTS odatda planner uchun ham qulayroq (anti-join).

questions.question: Bu ikki hisob nega farq qiladi?
questions.snippet: SELECT count(*), count(rating), avg(rating) FROM reviews;
questions.explanation: count(*) barcha row'ni sanaydi; count(rating) NULL bo'lmaganlarini; avg(rating) esa NULL'larni butunlay e'tiborsiz qoldiradi (yig'indi/NULL bo'lmagan soni). Ya'ni avg 'nolga teng' deb hisoblamaydi. NULL'ni 0 sifatida sanash kerak bo'lsa: avg(coalesce(rating,0)). Shuningdek sum() hech row bo'lmasa NULL qaytaradi, 0 emas.

questions.question: Nega `SELECT ... WHERE lower(email) = $1` index'dan foydalanmayapti?
questions.snippet: CREATE INDEX idx_email ON users(email);
questions.explanation: Ustunga funksiya qo'llanganda oddiy B-tree index ishlamaydi (predikat sargable emas). Yechim: expression index — CREATE INDEX ON users(lower(email)); yoki citext tipi. Xuddi shu qoida: WHERE created_at::date = '2024-01-01' o'rniga created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-01-02' yozing.

questions.question: Bu migratsiya production'da nega xavfli?
questions.snippet:
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new';
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status ON orders(status);
questions.explanation: Postgres 11+ da volatile bo'lmagan DEFAULT bilan ustun qo'shish jadvalni qayta yozmaydi (tez), lekin baribir qisqa ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock oladi — uzoq ishlayotgan query orqasida navbatga turib, butun jadvalni bloklaydi. CREATE INDEX esa CONCURRENTLY'siz yozuvlarni index qurilguncha bloklaydi. To'g'ri retsept: lock_timeout = '3s' + retry, CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (transaction ichida emas), va migratsiyani kichik qadamlarga bo'lish.

questions.question: `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` bilan ikki servis deadlock berayapti. Sabab va yechim?
questions.snippet:
-- A: UPDATE accounts WHERE id=1; UPDATE accounts WHERE id=2;
-- B: UPDATE accounts WHERE id=2; UPDATE accounts WHERE id=1;
questions.explanation: Klassik lock ordering deadlock: ikki tranzaksiya resurslarni teskari tartibda qulflaydi. Postgres deadlock_timeout (default 1s) dan keyin birini bekor qiladi: 'deadlock detected'. Yechim: barcha kod yo'llarida qat'iy bir xil tartib (masalan id bo'yicha o'sish: SELECT ... WHERE id = ANY($1) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE), yoki bitta ledger row'ga serializatsiya, yoki SKIP LOCKED bilan navbat. Ilova darajasida 40P01 xatosini retry qilish ham kerak.

questions.question: Nega `LIMIT 20 OFFSET 100000` sekin?
questions.snippet: SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 100000;
questions.explanation: OFFSET row'larni tashlab yubormaydi — ularni baribir o'qib, keyin tashlaydi. 100k offset = 100020 row o'qish. Yechim: keyset (seek) pagination — WHERE (created_at, id) < ($1,$2) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20. Bonus: keyset yangi row qo'shilganda dublikat/tushib qolish muammosini ham yopadi, OFFSET esa yopmaydi.

questions.question: Bu query nega kutilganidan kam qator qaytaradi?
questions.snippet:
SELECT u.id, u.email
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid';
options: `WHERE` filtri JOIN'dan keyin qo'llanadi va `NULL` qatorlarni kesib tashlaydi — LEFT JOIN amalda INNER JOIN'ga aylanadi; shart `ON`ga ko'chirilishi kerak
questions.explanation: Outer join'da o'ng tomon shartlari `ON` ichida bo'lishi kerak: `LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id AND o.status = 'paid'`. Agar maqsad 'to'lovi yo'q userlar' bo'lsa — `WHERE o.id IS NULL` (anti-join). Bu xato kod review'da eng ko'p o'tib ketadigan SQL xatolaridan biri.

questions.question: `NOT IN` bilan nega bo'sh natija keladi?
questions.snippet:
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders);
options: `orders.user_id` ichida bitta `NULL` bo'lsa — butun shart `UNKNOWN` bo'ladi va hech qanday qator qaytmaydi; `NOT EXISTS` yoki `IS NOT NULL` filtri ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: `id NOT IN (1, NULL)` = `id <> 1 AND id <> NULL` = `... AND UNKNOWN` — hech qachon rost bo'lmaydi. `NOT EXISTS` NULL bilan to'g'ri ishlaydi va planner uchun ko'pincha samaraliroq (anti-join). Bu klassik jim bug: ma'lumotga bitta NULL kelgan kuni hisobot bo'shab qoladi.

questions.question: Pagination'da qatorlar takrorlanib/tushib qolyapti. Nega?
questions.snippet: SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 40;
options: `created_at` unique emas — teng qiymatlarda tartib barqaror emas, shuning uchun sahifalar orasida qator takrorlanadi yoki yo'qoladi; tie-breaker (`, id DESC`) va keyset pagination kerak
questions.explanation: Ikki muammo birga: (1) barqaror bo'lmagan tartib — har doim unique tie-breaker qo'shiladi; (2) OFFSET chuqurlashganda sekinlashadi (N qatorni tashlab o'tish) va yangi yozuvlar sahifani surib yuboradi. Yechim — keyset: `WHERE (created_at, id) < ($1, $2) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20`.

questions.question: `SELECT count(*)` katta jadvalda sekin. PostgreSQL'da nega va nima qilinadi?
options: MVCC tufayli aniq sanoq har qatorning ko'rinishini tekshirishni talab qiladi (index-only scan bo'lsa ham to'liq skan) — taxminiy sanoq (`pg_class.reltuples`), alohida hisoblagich jadval yoki keshlangan qiymat ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: MySQL InnoDB'da ham shunday. Amaliy yechimlar: UI'da 'taxminan N natija' (reltuples yoki `EXPLAIN` bahosi), filtrlangan sanoq uchun alohida agregat jadval (trigger yoki eventdan yangilanadi), yoki `count(*) OVER ()` bilan faqat joriy sahifa kontekstida. `count(1)` va `count(*)` bir xil tezlikda.
